items.summary: As Toronto deals with a housing crisis, some industry experts and homeowners say building laneway houses and garden suites should be easier. The city's numbers suggest the initiative is gaining some traction, but calls remain for less red tape.

items.title: Canada's Carney says US trade talks advance but no deal reached
Anwar meets Carney in Manila, with Malaysia-Canada energy and digital trade on the table
Geopolitics won’t affect Interpol assembly in Hong Kong: police chief
items.summary: Hong Kong’s police chief has dismissed concerns that geopolitical tensions could affect attendance at the coming Interpol general assembly to be held in the city, saying transnational cooperation on policing is “inevitable”.

items.title: China’s upgraded VT-4B export tank gets fourth-gen Type 100 tech ahead of Zhuhai show
items.summary: China has upgraded its VT-4 series main battle tank with cutting-edge technologies aimed at the international market, newly surfaced photos show ahead of the country’s premier defence exhibition in Zhuhai.

items.title: Forest fund announcement follows Carney’s absence from COP talks
items.summary: With trade dominating much of the agenda so far, Canada sought Sunday to bolster its environmental credentials by announcing new funding to help protect tropical forests through a project co-led by Brazil and Norway.
